narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -10.95 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.1762-0.1806 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.1819; the first objective pays 1.28R at 0.1745.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 0.1762-0.1806
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.1819 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 29/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, whales offering

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $5.1M -1.2% below · short liq $1.7M +2.3% above
